nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust crate manifest for the Waggle Tauri 2.0 desktop shell (v0.2.0), declaring the waggle_lib crate-type triple and dependencies including tauri with tray-icon, system plugins (dialog, shell, autostart, global-shortcut, notification, single-instance, updater), and tokio/reqwest/serde for async HTTP.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares crate-type as ["lib", "cdylib", "staticlib"] to support both desktop and mobile Tauri 2.0 targets.

nodes.name: tauri.conf.json
nodes.summary: Main Tauri 2.0 configuration for the Waggle desktop app (identifier com.egzakta.waggle), wiring the frontend dist from apps/web/dist, configuring the 1200×800 window, CSP security policy, system-tray icon, auto-updater endpoint (GitHub releases), NSIS Windows installer, and plugin permissions for dialog/shell/updater.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Tauri 2.0 schema; beforeBuildCommand chains sidecar build + resource checks before Vite build, ensuring the Node.js sidecar is bundled before packaging.

nodes.name: tauri.build-override.conf.json
nodes.summary: Tauri configuration override for production/CI builds that clears the beforeBuildCommand (to prevent double-execution when the build script manages it externally) and sets ad-hoc macOS code-signing identity ("-") for unsigned local builds.

nodes.name: tauri.dev-override.conf.json
nodes.summary: Tauri configuration override for local development that clears the beforeDevCommand (to skip the Vite dev server launch when run manually) and relaxes the CSP to allow unsafe-inline scripts and eval, enabling hot-module-reload and browser devtools in the dev WebView.
nodes.languageNotes: The relaxed CSP (unsafe-inline + unsafe-eval) is dev-only and intentionally absent from tauri.conf.json and the build override.
